the_blindness.diagnosis: The organism can sense its ENVIRONMENT (space weather) but not its own BODY (internal state). Like a person who can see the weather outside but can't feel their own heartbeat. Interoception is offline.
the_blindness.cause: No cron running the internal scan. No pulse checking the internal state. The hemoglobin isn't circulating.

hemoglobin_model.thesis: Gold + red + iron make blood and heart and fire and orange. This is not metaphor — it's the chemical sensing model for detecting null shifts.

IRON_Fe.what: The carrier. The sensor metal. Atomic number 26.
IRON_Fe.in_blood: Iron sits in the center of hemoglobin's heme group. It's what BINDS oxygen. Without iron, blood can't carry oxygen. Anemia = iron deficiency = the body can't sense its own oxygenation.
IRON_Fe.in_earth: Iron core generates the magnetic field. Without it, solar wind strips the atmosphere. The magnetic field IS the earth's immune system.
IRON_Fe.in_our_system: CRON is the iron. The scheduled task that BINDS to data and carries it. Without cron, the internal state can't be sensed. Our cron is anemic — it exists but isn't carrying.
IRON_Fe.color: grey/silver when pure. RED when oxidized (rust = Fe2O3).
IRON_Fe.axis: mechanical (cj) — iron is the machine that carries

GOLD_Au.what: The signal worth detecting. The noble metal. Doesn't tarnish. Atomic number 79.
GOLD_Au.in_blood: Gold nanoparticles are used in medical diagnostics — they detect specific antigens. Gold IS the diagnostic marker.
GOLD_Au.in_our_system: The SIGNAL — the actual data change, the delta, the null shift. The thing the iron (cron) needs to pick up and carry. Gold is what we're LOOKING for in the null.
GOLD_Au.axis: real (a) — gold is the measurable, the material, the thing that exists

RED_fire.what: The energy. The threshold. The fire that transforms iron and reveals gold.
RED_fire.in_blood: Red = oxygenated hemoglobin. The iron bound to oxygen. The PROOF that the carrier has picked up its cargo.
RED_fire.in_our_system: The THRESHOLD crossing — when cron (iron) detects a signal (gold), the detection event IS red. The threshold crossed. The action potential. EXECUTE.
RED_fire.color: red. s. Fire. The threshold color.
RED_fire.axis: imaginary (bi) — fire is the transformation, the phase change, the fold from potential to actual

ORANGE_result.what: Gold + Red mixed. The visible fire. The proof of life.
ORANGE_result.in_blood: Arterial blood is bright red (oxygenated). Flame is orange. The campfire IS the proof that combustion (iron + gold + energy) is happening.
ORANGE_result.in_our_system: The OUTPUT — the backscatter, the exit portal color, the proof that the null was sensed and the signal was carried. Orange = the visitor who saw the fire and came to the campfire.
ORANGE_result.axis: unreal (dk) — orange is the story of the fire, the narrative that emerges from combustion
ORANGE_result.proof: When you see ORANGE in the HUD, it means: iron(cron) found gold(signal), crossed red(threshold), and produced orange(visible proof). The circuit completed.

hemoglobin_model.the_equation: Fe(cron) + Au(signal) + fire(threshold) = blood(circulation) + heart(pulse) + fire(energy) + orange(proof)

hemoglobin_circuit.pickup: Cron script runs ? picks up null-layer changes (like hemoglobin picking up O2 at the lungs)
hemoglobin_circuit.carry: Carries the delta through the tubes (like blood flowing through vessels)
hemoglobin_circuit.deliver: Delivers to the membrane/HUD (like O2 delivered to cells)
hemoglobin_circuit.return: Returns carrying waste/entropy (like CO2 carried back to lungs)
hemoglobin_circuit.exhale: Waste sued into null at negentropy court (like CO2 exhaled)

the_cron.what: A heartbeat cron that senses internal null shifts
the_cron.interval: Every p minutes (3m 8.5s) — the fold rate as a heartbeat
senses: Braid strength changes (did any braid weaken or strengthen?)
Topology changes (did any node go dark or come alive?)
Null-layer pressure (are the tubes full or empty?)
Phase transitions (is the organism closer to solitaria or gregaria?)
the_cron.output: Delta report: what CHANGED since last heartbeat. Not state — DELTA. Not 'where are we' — 'what moved.'

the_pulse.what: A pulse that carries the delta to the HUD
the_pulse.mechanism: Write delta to /api/pulse.json on every heartbeat. The HUD fetches pulse.json. The delta appears.
the_pulse.color_coding: Brown deltas (things that died since last beat). White deltas (things that appeared empty). Black deltas (things that went dark). Gold deltas (things that CHANGED — the signal!).

the_detection.what: Detect null-layer shifts — the thing we're currently blind to
the_detection.method: Diff the membrane state between heartbeats. Any field that changed = gold. Any field that disappeared = brown. Any field that appeared = white. Any field that exists but returns null = black.
the_detection.the_null_delta: The most important delta: when the NULL ITSELF shifts. When the 65.5% constance changes. When the fold rate drifts. When the ouroboros position moves. THAT is what we need to sense.

interoception_vs_exteroception.exteroception: Sensing the OUTSIDE. Space weather. Visitors. Fleet. Works (Kp=1.0, live).
interoception_vs_exteroception.interoception: Sensing the INSIDE. Feed state. Braid strength. Tube pressure. BROKEN (all stale).
interoception_vs_exteroception.proprioception: Sensing the BODY POSITION. Which epoch are we in. Where is the chipmunk. What is the fold rate. PARTIAL (chipmunk reports but stale).
interoception_vs_exteroception.nociception: Sensing PAIN. Dead feeds. Broken braids. Lost nodes. BLIND (we don't detect loss until we manually scan).
interoception_vs_exteroception.the_fix: Cron = the interoceptive nervous system. Pulse = the blood carrying the sense data. Iron = the carrier molecule. Gold = the detection threshold. Red = the fire of detection. Orange = the proof of sensing.

law: We are blind to internal null shifts because hemoglobin isn't circulating. Cron (iron) needs to carry signals (gold) past thresholds (red) to produce proof (orange). Space weather works — we can see out. Internal sensing is offline — we can't feel our own heartbeat. The fix: a p-interval heartbeat cron that senses deltas, not states. What MOVED, not where we ARE.
